pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Subscriptions with entitlements derived from the subscription itself — not copied onto the user.

billing.successBody: Your plan activates as soon as the webhook lands — usually within a second.
billing.cancelBody: Nothing was charged. You can pick a plan again whenever you like.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: What this workspace may do right now, derived from its subscription rather than stored on it.
account.changeSeatsFloor: {count, plural, =1 {# seat is} other {# seats are}} in use. Remove the member before buying fewer.
account.changeDueNothing: Nothing — the unused time comes off your next invoice
account.changeHolds: This price is quoted as of now and holds for {minutes} minutes.
account.changeRequested: Asked for. The plan moves here once the invoice for it is paid — that arrives as a webhook, usually within a second.
account.changeInactive: Only an active subscription can change plan. Settle or restart it first.
account.changeExpired: That price is out of date. Pick the plan again for a fresh one.
account.changeChanged: This workspace's subscription changed while you were deciding. Pick the plan again.
account.changeFailed: Could not change plan. Try again in a moment.
account.capCurrent: {count, plural, =0 {Capped at 0 — nothing past your quota is billed.} =1 {Capped at 1 unit past your quota.} other {Capped at # units past your quota.}}
account.capUncapped: No cap — you are billed for whatever the month runs to.
account.capSaved: Saved. It applies from the next request.
account.capInvalid: The cap has to be a whole number of units, or empty for no cap.
account.capFailed: Could not save the cap. Try again in a moment.
account.capNote: A cap is counted in units past your plan's allowance, not in money, because a unit's price is Stripe's and would move the ceiling under you. Requests past it are refused rather than billed, and the month's invoice never carries more than the cap. Leave it empty for no cap.
account.noticeCurrent: Notices about this workspace go out in {language}.
account.noticeSaved: Saved. The next notice goes out in it.
account.noticeFailed: Could not save the language. Try again in a moment.
account.noticeNote: The language we write to you in: the mail when a payment fails, when a subscription ends, and when a month comes up on its spend cap. The pages themselves follow the address you open and your browser's own preference, so changing this does not move you off the one you are reading. Stripe composes its own receipts and card notices, in the language on its customer record.
account.invoicesEmpty: Nothing has been invoiced to this workspace yet.
account.invoicesEnd: That is as far back as this workspace's invoices go.
account.invoicesUnavailable: Could not reach Stripe for this list just now. Nothing is missing — reload in a moment.
account.invoicesNote: Read from Stripe as this page loaded, and kept nowhere here, so what you see is the invoice itself rather than a copy of it. The documents are Stripe's and open there. Older invoices than these are a page back through Stripe, or all of them at once in the billing portal below.
account.portalEmpty: Pick a plan first — there is nothing to manage yet.
account.portalFailed: Could not open the billing portal. Try again in a moment.
account.portalNote: Cancelling, resuming and card changes happen at Stripe. This app never edits a subscription itself; it reads the result back from the webhook.
account.signedOut: Sign in to see this workspace's plan and billing.
account.noTenant: This account does not belong to a workspace yet.
account.ambiguous: This account belongs to several workspaces, and choosing between them is not built yet.

admin.title: Transactions
admin.subtitle: Every subscription attempt for this workspace and what each API key spent, newest first, a page at a time.
admin.noKeys: No API key matches this filter.
admin.replayNote: A delivery that never arrived can be re-fetched from the provider by its event id and put back through the same path the live one takes. “Duplicate” is an answer rather than a failure: it means nothing was missed. Every attempt is recorded against this workspace, with the account that made it.
admin.replayRefused: No event with that id belongs to this workspace.
admin.replayFailed: That did not go through — try again.
admin.scopeNote: There are no roles yet, so this page shows the workspace the signed-in account belongs to and nothing else. Rows are read newest first from a cursor, so a checkout that lands while you are reading cannot shift the page under you.
admin.signedOut: Sign in to see this workspace's transactions.
admin.noTenant: This account does not belong to a workspace yet.
admin.ambiguous: This account belongs to several workspaces, and choosing between them is not built yet.

pastDue.subject: We could not take your payment
pastDue.heading: We could not take your payment
pastDue.body: Hi {tenant}, the latest payment for your {plan} plan did not go through. Your card issuer usually gives no reason, and an expired card is the common one.
pastDue.cta: Nothing has been switched off. {plan} keeps working while we retry, so there is time to update the card:
pastDue.footer: If you have already updated it, the next retry will settle and you can ignore this.

goodbye.subject: Your subscription has ended
goodbye.heading: Your subscription has ended
goodbye.body: Hi {tenant}, your {plan} plan has ended and you will not be billed for it again. Your account is still here, now on the Free plan.
goodbye.cta: Whenever you want {plan} back, it starts again here:
goodbye.footer: Thanks for the time you spent with us.

capApproaching.subject: You are close to your spend cap
capApproaching.preview: {units} of your {cap} extra messages are gone
capApproaching.heading: You are close to your spend cap
capApproaching.body: Hi {tenant}, this month has used {units} of the {cap} messages past your {plan} allowance that you agreed to be billed for.
capApproaching.cta: Nothing has stopped. When the {cap} are gone, further calls are refused until the allowance resets at the start of next month — so if this month needs more than that, the ceiling is yours to raise:
capApproaching.footer: You will not be billed past the cap, whether or not you move it.

capReached.subject: Your spend cap has paused further usage
capReached.preview: Calls past your {plan} allowance are being refused
capReached.heading: Your spend cap has paused further usage
capReached.body: Hi {tenant}, this month has reached the cap of {cap} messages past your {plan} allowance, and calls beyond it are now being refused.
capReached.cta: Everything inside the {plan} plan itself goes on working. To carry on past the allowance this month, raise the ceiling here:
capReached.footer: Or leave it where it is: the allowance resets at the start of next month, and you will be billed for {cap} and no more.
